description: This file implements operator handling and evaluation logic for a build system or scripting language, including assignment, arithmetic, and logical operators, with classes and functions for managing values, scopes, and error handling.

classes.name: ValueDestination
classes.description: Helper class for managing assignment destinations in different scopes or lists.

methods.name: ValueDestination::Init
methods.description: Initializes the destination for assignment, resolving identifiers, scope, or list access.

methods.name: ValueDestination::GetExistingValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value in the destination scope or list.

methods.name: ValueDestination::GetExistingMutableValueIfExists
methods.description: Retrieves a mutable reference to the existing value if it exists and can be modified.

methods.name: ValueDestination::SetValue
methods.description: Sets a new value at the destination.

methods.name: ValueDestination::MakeUndefinedIdentifierForModifyError
methods.description: Generates an error for undefined identifiers during modification.
